claims.statement: Wood and derived products such as furniture are among the commodity groups identified by the Commission as relevant to EUDR.
Current Commission dates show EUDR application from December 2026 for large and medium operators and June 2027 for most micro and small operators.

economics.acquisition_route: Start in one Polish furniture cluster with importer-backed supply
economics.founder_net_worth_path: Unvalidated: 300m PLN annual EU niche volume at a 2% fee could yield 6m PLN revenue and over 5m PLN founder equity in years 6-9
economics.founder_time: 3-5 hours/day with timber inspection and legal work outsourced
economics.gross_margin_basis: Unvalidated: 65-82% without taking title or financing inventory
economics.payback: Unvalidated: 12-20 months at 20m PLN annual transacted value
economics.pricing: Unvalidated: 1.5-3% of contracted timber value plus 2000 PLN annual buyer access
economics.retention_or_repeat: Repeat purchasing follows production schedules and supplier substitutions

fingerprint.compounding_advantage: Exclusive supplier listings plus lot-level fulfillment and evidence-quality history create liquidity and trust
fingerprint.customer: Polish furniture, flooring and wood-product SMEs
fingerprint.distribution_mechanism: Furniture clusters, timber importers and procurement-software partnerships
fingerprint.offer_and_business_model: Forward lot listings, standardized evidence rooms, substitution alerts and supplier fulfillment scores
fingerprint.payer_and_paid_event: Buyer pays transaction fee when a documented lot reservation converts to a supply contract
fingerprint.problem_trigger: A production order needs timber with timely, product-linked EUDR evidence

founder_fit: Quantitative matching and risk scoring fit
Poland has a relevant manufacturing wedge
Can validate with data rooms before handling goods
risks: Evidence does not eliminate buyer liability

structure.control_point: documented timber-lot inventory and reservation rights
structure.critical_dependency: Evidence-ready suppliers must offer enough volume without the platform assuming regulated operator duties

thesis: Operate a narrow forward market where Polish furniture makers reserve documented timber lots from suppliers whose plot and legality evidence is pre-packaged, while buyers retain due-diligence responsibility.
title: EUDR-Ready Timber Lot Exchange
uncertainties: Polish buyer demand, take rate and available documented supply are unvalidated
Contract enforceability across borders is unknown
